map.先天八卦（伏羲）主“对待”，排布为乾南坤北、离东坎西、震东北兑东南、巽西南艮西北: Pre-heaven bagua (Fuxi) centres on mutual opposition, laid out as Qian south and Kun north, Li east and Kan west, Zhen northeast and Dui southeast, Xun southwest and Gen northwest, to expound the principle of yin-yang opposition; post-heaven bagua (King Wen) centres on circulation, laid out as Li south and Kan north, Zhen east and Dui west, Qian northwest and Kun southwest, Xun southeast and Gen northeast, matching real directions and the flow of qi. The two serve different purposes and must not be mixed.
